speaker: client
text: The ESP32 module’s C18 (0.2 µF) and C19 (47 µF) decoupling capacitors sit 12–15 mm from its 3V3 pin (pin 2), while the specification calls for no more than 4 mm. Could we place a small 0.2 µF capacitor closer to that pin? The bulk C19 can remain where it is.

speaker: freelancer
text: No problems are expected from the ESP32 decoupling capacitors, so they can remain unchanged. The module also has decoupling capacitors internally.
